purpose: Attribute synthetic shape/color robustness to pixel extraction versus an unchanged fresh NewBrain learner.

segmentation.resize: nearest, aspect-preserving, at most30x30 in32x32 black; never upsample

heldout_parameters.centers: odd coordinates; screen quadrant arrangements withheld from training
heldout_parameters.source_geometry: synthetic only; no actual lens or display simulation
heldout_parameters.background_assignment: cycled across repeats within color-shape pairs; screen background varies independently of object count

controls: same frozen weights with original global preprocessing
factorized nearest using same training pool and component extractor

matching.objective: maximum valid match count, then total IoU

metrics: correct accepted object recall over all known objects
unknown full-frame false acceptance and per-matched-unknown rate
unknown unsafe accept frame includes unmatched accepted predictions on mixed scenes
interpretation: No webcam readiness, arbitrary screen understanding, OCR, person recognition, story comprehension, biological fidelity or reliable unknown detection claim. No significance claim from dependent synthetic cases. All seeds and outcomes retained, no best-seed selection.
timestamp_scope: Synthetic case index clock only; input provenance is not a continuous video or capture timing benchmark.
